description: This file defines `ResumeSourceBuilder`, a builder class for creating a resumable Akka Streams source with configurable backoff, restart policies, and seed management. It is part of a control flow utility package within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ResumeSourceBuilder
classes.description: A generic builder class for constructing an Akka Source that supports automatic resumption and retry with configurable parameters such as backoff durations, restart limits, seed functions, and error mapping.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the resume source using current builder settings, verifying all required fields are non-null.

methods.name: minBackoff
methods.description: Sets the minimum backoff duration after a recoverable error.

methods.name: maxBackoff
methods.description: Sets the maximum backoff duration after a recoverable error.

methods.name: maxRestarts
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of restart attempts before failing the stream. Negative value indicates unlimited retries.

methods.name: recovery
methods.description: Sets the recovery interval duration; resets backoff if this time passes without error.

methods.name: initialSeed
methods.description: Sets the initial seed (state) to start the stream.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Assigns the function that creates or resumes the stream from a seed.

methods.name: lookBehind
methods.description: Specifies how many recent elements to keep for seed computation.

methods.name: nextSeed
methods.description: Sets the function for computing the next seed based on recent stream elements.

methods.name: mapError
methods.description: Configures how errors are mapped to recoverable or unrecoverable states.
